text:
amy: Morning team — quick triage snapshot: ~82 open tickets, noticeable spike in embeddings failures overnight. I can take a sweep but want quick ownership first. Any blockers?
noah: On it, amy. Looks like OOMs on dedicated-x for several customers. I rolled an emergency fallback to cpu-embed-v1 for affected sessions.
rachel: I got a billing complaint about duplicate webhook retries (SUP-1148). Adding repro and screenshots now.
triage-bot: Automated: 7 high-priority tickets escalated; 3 new since 0300 UTC.
kevin: Quick question — do we have an existing macro for embeddings failures? I can draft one but want to avoid duplication.
amy: I don't think so; @kevin please draft and @sanjay can check infra quotas. Also note: add a step to check customer payload size before suggesting retries.
sanjay: Checking gpu-pool-A now — utilization at 94%. Autoscale didn't kick due to a policy label mismatch. Opening INF-202 to track.
noah: FYI the logs show a pattern: sequence lengths > 4096 with model-x triggers the OOM. I added a temp UI note to mark affected customers as 'embedding-tested' so agents don't retry blindly.
rachel: :thumbsup: I'll include that note in SUP-1148 and create macro 'billing-duplicate-webhook' with repro + mitigation.
kevin: Draft macro (pasted):

```
Title: embeddings-failure-steps
1) Ask customer for model and sequence length
2) Clear local cache: `curl -X POST https://support-api.internal/cache/clear`
3) Switch to cpu-embed-v1 and retry
4) If still failing, escalate to eng-ml with logs and sample payload
```

Thoughts?
amy: This is good. Add link to the runtime troubleshooting doc and expected timeout/seq_len thresholds. Also step to capture a small bundle of logs (kv-cache, memory stats).
kevin: Added docs link and log step, pushed PR #432 to support-macros. Assigning to @amy for quick review.
triage-bot: Reminder: Daily SLA report will publish in 30m.
amy: Ownership check: @noah take embeddings incidents, @rachel own SUP-1148/billing dup, @sanjay run infra escalation and follow INF-202, @kevin finish macro PR and tag docs. I'll sweep remaining high-priority tickets after this async standup.
noah: Got it, starting checklist.
rachel: On it, will update thread with SUP-1148 notes.
sanjay: INF-202 created and linked to cloud ops, pinged for autoscale rule fix. Will update once they confirm.
amy: :thumbsup: Thanks team — post any blockers here and I'll reassign if needed.
